main_text.head: JOHANNIS ALTHVSII J. C. clarissimi, CIVILIS CONVERSATIONIS LIBER PRIMVS, qui est De conuersatione communi.
CAPUT I. De generalibus adfectionibus communis conuersationis.
main_text.p: ONVERSATIO ciuilis est ars moribus decentibus vtendi. vel, ars mores secundum decorum & rectam rationem conformandi. Eodem sensu etiam ETHICA vocari potest, quare-nera nihil aliud, quam ars decore conuersandi cum hominibus.

Mores boni secundum rectam rationem conformati & decori, sunt sermo & habitus corporis naturæ & adfectioni negotii quod agitur, & personis conueniens & adcommodatus, referes, exprimens & significans decentem, aptam & concinnam agentis & conuersantis affectione,

page.notes: Historiated initial "C" with ornamental woodcut frame at the start of the first paragraph; the text "ONVERSATIO" is set with a large initial. Some words in the first paragraph (e.g. "quare-nera") are printed as shown; "quarenera" appears as a run-on of the line break. The sign at the right margin is a printed mark, not text. Possible misprints: "referes" and "quare-nera" left as printed.
